summary: Very steep narrow street kerb with homes 12-13 m away on the section's side.
reasons: Cars park here but residents everywhere

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings at 12, 13, 13 and 19 m along the stretch; houses on both sides of the street.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars park on the kerb so room exists, but the grade is about 15% (max 17%).
drivers.convention: Residential parking with 2P resident-permit signs; parked cars are common.

sun_shade: Mostly open to the road; trees shade the south end from the west.

best_section.where: West kerb of Moorak Street, uphill end near the lane junction
